method: Sample the retained fixed three-slot VCD on rising core/UCE clocks inside the exact measured run_window; require all 33 hints to allocate, all 33 AXI requests to carry nonzero prefetch IDs, and no UCE or installer drop.

fix.cause: A hint dispatched while the D-cache was idle could reach the memory pipe after dcache_busy asserted. dcache_pkt_v suppressed that hint, but only a hint that entered the D-cache could assert the old replay signal, so the unissued hint retired.
fix.change: Pipeline the late dcache_busy suppression alongside the hint identity and include it in cache_replay_v_o.

limits: The result uses the synthetic 40-cycle memory model and 32-bit minimal wrapper, not physical DDR.
The run reached checked guest, core, and host pass markers before the pre-existing DPI finalization assertion made the process exit nonzero.
The 304-cycle residual relative to ten slots is measured queue-pressure overhead; this trace does not establish the physical FPGA endpoint.
